title: Crash in QQuickItemGrabResult::render when double-clicking a folder in a panel Folder View popup (list mode)
line: Double-clicking a folder in a panel Folder View popup in list mode no longer crashes or freezes Plasma.
explanation: Every selection change in Folder View immediately starts grabbing drag images of the selected rows (onSelectionDone: main.generateDragImage()). The release of a double-click re-selects the folder, which starts a grab of its row, and the same click then opens the folder, whose model reset deletes that row while the render thread is still rendering the grab. The render thread then posts an event to the freed grab result and plasmashell crashes, or freezes when it locks a freed mutex. The change defers drag image generation with Qt.callLater, so it runs after the folder has been opened and only grabs rows that still exist.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: fix crash when opening a folder in a popup

Double-clicking a folder in a list-mode popup grabbed the drag image of
the clicked row right before opening the folder deleted it, so the grab
could finish on a deleted item. Generate drag images with Qt.callLater.

BUG: 527739

patches.diff:
From 7d05d982ede487cf496777d173f8bd8820a4a4cf Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 17:14:41 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] containments/desktop: fix crash when opening a folder in a
 popup

Double-clicking a folder in a list-mode popup grabbed the drag image of
the clicked row right before opening the folder deleted it, so the grab
could finish on a deleted item. Generate drag images with Qt.callLater.

BUG: 527739
---
 containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderView.qml | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderView.qml b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderView.qml
index b858d16f7a..4cd87425dd 100644
--- a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderView.qml
+++ b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderView.qml
@@ -1244,7 +1244,7 @@ FocusScope {
             // Create drag images before dragging
             // Due to async operations we can't call this before dragging starts,
             // but we have to call it after a selection is done
-            onSelectionDone: main.generateDragImage()
+            onSelectionDone: Qt.callLater(main.generateDragImage)
 
             onListingCompleted: {
                 if (!gridView.model && root.expanded) {
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: Back / double-click Documents in the list-mode popup; plasmashell crashes at round 8 (popup and panel vanish).
With the fix: the same loop runs 25 rounds without a crash (175 rounds in total).
Master, first double-click on Documents: plasmashell froze (render thread stuck in QQuickItemGrabResult::render); the popup never updates.
With the fix: the double-click opens Documents.
With the fix: dragging Downloads out of the popup still shows its drag image and the drop menu.
